# Vendored dependency audit inventory

Generated by `node scripts/vendor-audit.mjs` from browser-library source/integrity
records and Mermaid's conservative dependency notice inventory. `--check` rejects
drift. Run `npm --prefix frontend/vendor/mermaid audit --package-lock-only` to check these
exact versions. Do not run npm install/ci here: this is an audit snapshot, not a
build recipe. Aliases preserve multiple embedded versions without resolving new
transitive ranges. The inventory deliberately includes source-lock build/parser
packages that may have been removed from the bundle; findings need review against
shipped code. It cannot establish dependency reachability or replace source-map
review, integrity checks and license review when rebuilding a vendor bundle.

The security rebuild uses lodash-es 4.18.1 throughout, resolving the
[template imports advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc)
and [array-path advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-f23m-r3pf-42rh).
The generated source map was checked for the resolved versions. The inventory
and licenses match the rebuilt source lock; no advisory suppression is configured.
See [rebuild instructions](REBUILD.md).
